body.name: projected simultaneous primitive-region envelope
body.construction:
Let \(\mathcal R_n\) be any nonempty compact simultaneous confidence region for \(\beta_n\), intersected with \(\Delta(\mathcal C)\times\Delta(\mathcal X)\times[0,1]^{\mathcal C\times\mathcal X}\).  Define the projected-region confidence envelope by
\[
\mathrm{CI}_n^{\mathrm{proj}}
=\left[
\inf_{\widetilde\beta\in\mathcal R_n}L(\widetilde\beta),
\ \sup_{\widetilde\beta\in\mathcal R_n}U(\widetilde\beta)
\right].
\]
